evidence: Modifies `src/ipc/capnp/protocol.cpp` to fix event loop lifetime and concurrency issues in Cap'n Proto IPC serve mode.
rationale: Prevents potential use-after-free crashes and unexpected termination in multiprocess `serve()` mode by properly managing event loop references and thread safety. The PR description notes that methods called from background threads 'do not hold their own references and therefore depend on the parent connection remaining alive,' risking crashes if the connection closes.
